title: One-step query transition
statement: Let $M$ be a Boolean multitape Turing machine, let $x$ and $v$ be finite Boolean words, and let $c$ be a configuration of $M$ on input $v$ whose state is $s$. For any natural number $i$ and any oracle $o$ assigning a Boolean answer to each of the two query indices and each Boolean word, one step of the compiled program from the encoded configuration with phase ask leaves the encoded machine configuration and the auxiliary register contents unchanged. Its resulting phase is bit if $o$ answers true on query index $0$ and the pair encoding of $x$ with the binary expansion of $i$; otherwise the phase is work with no pending write and a false left-boundary flag.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a Boolean multitape Turing machine
$c$ is a configuration of $M$ on input $v$
$o$ maps each of the two query indices and each Boolean word to a Boolean answer
